name: catalog-has-40-independent-tasks
description: The compiled catalog exposes exactly 40 runnable task directories.
given: A freshly compiled repository using the live upstream datasets and committed local packets
then: Exactly 40 unique tasks are found with one prompt and one normalized task file each

name: every-task-has-real-inputs
description: Every task resolves to at least one non-empty upstream source document.
given: The compiler has downloaded the selected benchmark materials
when: source_docs paths are resolved, including AA shared-pool symlinks
then: Every task has readable non-empty source files and every source file is represented in the SHA-256 manifest

name: coverage-spans-seven-benchmark-families
description: The suite combines four sourced benchmark families, retail diagnostics, Daytona Windows workflows, and DataAgentBench.
given: All selected upstream task IDs and local packets are compiled
then: The dataset counts are 4, 6, 6, 4, 3, 10, and 7 for a total of 40 tasks

name: expected-deliverables-are-declared
description: Every prompt has one or more explicit output artifacts.
when: the deliverables field is checked against prompt.md
then: At least one non-empty expected filename is declared for every task

name: dataagentbench-live-source-rebuild
description: Seven DataAgentBench packets rebuild independently from the pinned GitHub revision and live Hugging Face data mirror.
given: An empty temporary task tree and network access to the real upstream services
when: compile_dataagentbench downloads metadata, graders, and query-specific databases
then: Seven complete task packets are produced and all mirrored files match the upstream size and SHA-256 manifest

name: dataagentbench-official-validators-accept-ground-truth
description: Every packaged DataAgentBench validator can score its corresponding answer contract.
when: the official validate function receives that task's ground_truth.csv content
then: All seven validators return a passing result
